talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 291 solo PCPs winding down in California; 58 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Los Angeles 90006, Long Beach 90806, Inglewood 90301) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~34,803 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.
**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Madera County, Lassen County) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 23 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~1,586,400 patients across 1322 at-risk practices statewide.
